state:
- The repurposing claim is exposure-defined, but no unbound concentration, free fraction, or half-life is stated even as a labeled unverified recollection, so the test dose is a placeholder. State a recalled unbound Css or Cmax range, mark it unverified, and lock the assay concentration to that ceiling before accrual.
- The load-bearing bridge—that on-target DHODH blockade still depletes pyrimidines and matures blasts when salvage uridine is already at plasma or marrow levels—is asserted without a salvage-capacity mechanism (UCK activity, uridine Km, or AML-versus-normal difference) that would make depletion possible. Specify that assumption and treat nucleotide repletion at the verified physiologic uridine level as an immediate falsifier of the efficacy arm.
- Go/no-go cutoffs (15 percentage points, 1.0 log2, 30 percent nucleotide loss, annexin-V within 10 points, 100 micromolar rescue) and the in vivo arm are unanchored: no tie to S4 effect sizes or assay variance, and no PDX dose, route, or schedule that holds free teriflunomide at the ceiling. Calibrate thresholds on a brequinar pilot and pre-specify the dosing regimen; put a normal CFU reduction limit inside the selectivity falsifier rather than outside it.
